text:
Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
4:10 AM

At ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 chip. These matter more than anything else for programming.

RAM: 16 GB is the minimum, since an editor, browser tabs and Docker eat memory fast. Pick one where RAM can be upgraded later.
Processor: Ryzen 5 or 7 (7000 series or newer) gives the best speed and battery for the money. A MacBook Air with an M-series chip is also worth a look if you find one in budget.
Screen and keyboard: a 1080p matte or IPS screen and a comfortable keyboard. You'll stare at code for hours.
Graphics card: skip it unless you'll train AI projects or build games. That money is better spent on RAM and build quality.

What will you mostly build: web or app work, or AI and games? I can then look up current options and compare them for you.
